# Functions

```{r, warning = FALSE}

###################################################### UCell violin plot 

plot_ucell_violin <- function(
    df, 
    score_col,  
    title = "Gene Score", 
    subtitle = "CMF_TGF vs CMFHM_TGF",
    colors = c("CMF_TGF" = "#005EA8", "CMFHM_TGF" = "#9F1C67"),
    comparisons = list(c("CMF_TGF", "CMFHM_TGF"))
) {
  
  # Use .data[[score_col]] to evaluate the dynamic string
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = orig.ident, y = .data[[score_col]], fill = orig.ident)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, color = NA, scale = "area") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif" 
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x        = "Condition",
      y        = "UCell Score"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

###################################################### UCell violin plot facetted

plot_ucell_violin.facetted <- function(
    df, 
    title = "CF: Deconstruction of Pro-Fibrotic Response ± Macrophages", 
    subtitle = "UCell functional sub-modules (CMF_TGF vs CMFHM_TGF)",
    colors = c("CMF_TGF" = "#005EA8", "CMFHM_TGF" = "#9F1C67"),
    comparisons = list(c("CMF_TGF", "CMFHM_TGF")),
    ncol = 2
) {
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = orig.ident, y = Score, fill = orig.ident, color = orig.ident)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    facet_wrap(~ Module, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
    
    # Add pairwise Wilcoxon test p-value
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif"
    ) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x        = "Condition",
      y        = "UCell Score"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, hjust = 0),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position  = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

#################################################### Raincloud Plots

raincloud.plots <- function(gene_list, 
                                   plot_title, 
                                   plot_subtitle, 
                                   seurat_obj = Data, 
                                   colors = gradient_colors4) {

  
  valid_genes <- intersect(gene_list, rownames(seurat_obj))
  expression_matrix <- FetchData(seurat_obj, vars = c(valid_genes, "ident")) 

  
  rain_data <- expression_matrix %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Cell_ID") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(valid_genes), 
      names_to = "Gene", 
      values_to = "Expression"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Condition = ident)
  

  raincloud_plot <- ggplot(rain_data, aes(x = Condition, y = Expression, fill = Condition, color = Condition)) +
    geom_rain(
      alpha = 0.6,
      violin.args = list(color = NA),          
      boxplot.args = list(outlier.shape = NA), 
      point.args = list(
        size = 0.4,                            
        alpha = 0.4                            
      ),
    group = 1
    ) +
    
    facet_wrap(~Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title    = plot_title,
      subtitle = plot_subtitle,
      x        = "Experimental Conditions",
      y        = "Normalized Expression Level"
    ) +
    
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10), 
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(raincloud_plot)
}


```

# Cellscores in Cardiac Fibroblasts {.tabset}

## Pro-Fibrotic score

Comparing CMFHM_TGF vs. CMF_TGF

```{r, warning = FALSE}

################################ Variables 

current_score_name <- "Pro_fibrotic_Score"  

current_genes <- c(
            "ADAM12", "ADAM19", "ADAMTS2", "ADAMTS4", "ADAMTS6", "ADAMTS12", "ADAMTS14", "ADAMTS16",
            "ADAMTS17", "CCN2", "CDH2", "CDH11", "COL4A1", "COL4A2", "COL5A1", "COL5A2", "COL8A1", 
            "COL8A2", "COL10A1", "COL11A1", "COL12A1", "COL13A1", "COL15A1", "COMP", "FAP", "FLRT2", 
            "FN1", "IGFBP7", "ITGA11", "ITGAV", "ITGB1", "ITGB5", "ITGBL1", "LAMB1", "MMP13", "PDGFA", 
            "PLAU", "PLAUR", "PLOD2", "POSTN", "PXDN", "RHOA", "RUNX1", "SEMA7A", "SERPINE1", "SPHK1",
            "SPOCK1", "SRPX2", "TGFBR1", "THBS1", "THBS2", "THY1", "TIMP3", "TNFAIP6", "TNFRSF12A", "VIM")

scoretitle <- "Pro-Fibrotic Score"
Celltype <- "CF"
comp <- c("CMF_TGF", "CMFHM_TGF")
comptitle <- "CMFHM_TGF vs. CMF_TGF"
plot_title <- "CF: Pro-Fibrotic Score: TGF-β Response ± Macrophages"
plot_subtitle <- "CMF_TGF (No Macrophages) vs CMFHM_TGF (With Macrophages)"


seurat_obj <- subset(Data, cell_type == "Cardiac Fibroblasts")

########################### Prep

features_list <- list()
features_list[[current_score_name]] <- current_genes

seurat_obj <- AddModuleScore_UCell(
  obj = seurat_obj,
  features = features_list,
  name = "_UCell")

score_col <- paste0(current_score_name, "_UCell")

# Filter data for plots
df_plot <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>% 
  dplyr::filter(orig.ident %in% comp)

########################### Violin Plot

p_violin <- plot_ucell_violin(
  df = df_plot, 
  score_col = score_col,     
  title = plot_title,
  subtitle = plot_subtitle
)
print(p_violin)


########################### Feature Plot

seurat_obj_tgf <- subset(seurat_obj, TGF_status == "TGF_B")

p_split <- FeaturePlot_scCustom(
  seurat_obj_tgf, 
  features = score_col,     
  split.by = "orig.ident"
) 

p_split <- p_split + 
  plot_annotation(
    title    = plot_title,
    subtitle = plot_subtitle,
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, hjust = 0)
    )
  ) & 
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1.4,
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0),
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "plain")
  )

print(p_split)

```


### Adding Cliffs delta

The Cliffs delta to show effect size : 

it measures how often values in one group are larger than in another (ranging from -1 to 1)

Interpretation Scale for Cliff's Delta (d):

 - $\vert{}d\vert{} < 0.147$: Negligible
 - $\vert{}d\vert{} < 0.33$: Small
 - $\vert{}d\vert{} < 0.474$: Medium
 - $\vert{}d\vert{} \ge 0.474$: Large


Results: 

delta estimate: 0.4221959 (medium)

a medium d in combination with sign. p suggests that the pro-fibrotic score is mediumly decreased when macrophages are present.!

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

# Calculate Cliff's Delta between CMF_TGF and CMFHM_TGF
stats_formula <- as.formula(paste(score_col, "~ orig.ident"))
delta_res <- cliff.delta(stats_formula, data = df_plot)
print(delta_res)

```

### Checking the individual gene scores 

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

chunk_size <- 25
total_genes <- length(current_genes)

if (total_genes > 0) {
  for (i in seq(1, total_genes, by = chunk_size)) {
    
    end_idx <- min(i + chunk_size - 1, total_genes)
    slice_num <- ((i - 1) / chunk_size) + 1

    print(SCpubr::do_DotPlot(
      sample = seurat_obj_tgf, 
      features = current_genes[i:end_idx],
      dot.scale = 10,
      plot.title = plot_title,
      plot.subtitle = paste0("Slice ", slice_num, " (Genes ", i, " to ", end_idx, " of ", total_genes, ")")
    ))
  }
}


```

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

chunk_size <- 12
total_genes <- length(current_genes)

for (i in seq(1, total_genes, by = chunk_size)) {
  
  end_idx <- min(i + chunk_size - 1, total_genes)
  slice_num <- ((i - 1) / chunk_size) + 1
  print(raincloud.plots(
    gene_list     = current_genes[i:end_idx],
    plot_title    = paste0(Celltype, ": ", scoretitle, ": Gene distribution profiles across conditions"),
    plot_subtitle = paste0("Geneset = ", scoretitle," - Slice ", slice_num),
    seurat_obj    = seurat_obj_tgf,
    colors        = gradient_colors2
  ))
}

```

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
)

  )
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
print(p_split)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
plot_subtitle <- "CMF_TGF (No Macrophages) vs CMFHM_TGF (With Macrophages)"


seurat_obj <- subset(Data, cell_type == "Cardiomyocytes")

########################### Prep

features_list <- list()
features_list[[current_score_name]] <- current_genes

seurat_obj <- AddModuleScore_UCell(
  obj = seurat_obj,
  features = features_list,
  name = "_UCell")

score_col <- paste0(current_score_name, "_UCell")

# Filter data for plots
df_plot <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>% 
  dplyr::filter(orig.ident %in% comp)

########################### Violin Plot

p_violin <- plot_ucell_violin(
  df = df_plot, 
  score_col = score_col,     
  title = plot_title,
  subtitle = plot_subtitle,
  colors = colors,
  comparisons = list(comp)
)
print(p_violin)


########################### Feature Plot

seurat_obj_tgf <- subset(seurat_obj, TGF_status == "TGF_B")

p_split <- FeaturePlot_scCustom(
  seurat_obj_tgf, 
  features = score_col,     
  split.by = "orig.ident"
) 

p_split <- p_split + 
  plot_annotation(
    title    = plot_title,
    subtitle = plot_subtitle,
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, hjust = 0)
    )
  ) & 
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1.4,
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0),
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "plain")
  )

print(p_split)

```


### Adding Cliffs delta

The Cliffs delta to show effect size : 

Results: 

delta estimate: 0.03610958 (negligible)


a negligible d in combination with nonsign p suggests that the Cardiac Sarcomere assembly and cardiac muscle contraction score does not differe in Cardiomyocytes when Macrophages are present.!

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

stats_formula <- as.formula(paste(score_col, "~ orig.ident"))
delta_res <- cliff.delta(stats_formula, data = df_plot)
print(delta_res)

```

### Checking the individual gene scores 

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

chunk_size <- 25
total_genes <- length(current_genes)

if (total_genes > 0) {
  for (i in seq(1, total_genes, by = chunk_size)) {
    
    end_idx <- min(i + chunk_size - 1, total_genes)
    slice_num <- ((i - 1) / chunk_size) + 1

    print(SCpubr::do_DotPlot(
      sample = seurat_obj_tgf, 
      features = current_genes[i:end_idx],
      dot.scale = 10,
      plot.title = plot_title,
      plot.subtitle = paste0("Slice ", slice_num, " (Genes ", i, " to ", end_idx, " of ", total_genes, ")")
    ))
  }
}


```

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

chunk_size <- 12
total_genes <- length(current_genes)

for (i in seq(1, total_genes, by = chunk_size)) {
  
  end_idx <- min(i + chunk_size - 1, total_genes)
  slice_num <- ((i - 1) / chunk_size) + 1
  print(raincloud.plots(
    gene_list     = current_genes[i:end_idx],
    plot_title    = paste0(Celltype, ": ", scoretitle, ": Gene distribution profiles across conditions"),
    plot_subtitle = paste0("Geneset = ", scoretitle," - Slice ", slice_num),
    seurat_obj    = seurat_obj_tgf,
    colors        = gradient_colors2
  ))
}

```
